verdict.rationale: Grok Build has no dedicated shared workspace feature. The closest approximations are repo-level files: an `AGENTS.md` (plus compatible rule files) at the repo root holds conventions, build commands and architecture notes that Grok follows each session, and project `.mcp.json` files can live in the repo. `/share` can also share an individual session via URL. These are per-repo or per-session mechanisms, not a team workspace built from multiple docs and repos. Missing for 10: a team-level shared workspace or knowledge base that combines docs and multiple repos, team membership and access controls, and independent evidence of team use.
